integrity: Analytic convex-geometry proof and standalone supplementary finite numerical checker; no computationally inferred all-dimensional assertion.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real Euclidean nearest-point projectors; sharp equality for smooth compact full-dimensional convex bodies; arbitrary nonsmooth convex sets only have the universal bound; not an independent priority or proof validation.
title: Shape-independent sharp coordinatewise stability of smooth convex-body projection
